retainedReference.title: Abuja National Mosque
retainedReference.reason: No unique physical footprint or centerline with exact Wikidata identity has been resolved.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Ordinary pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only. No bespoke measured sources or copied photo textures.

pictures.author: Anass Sedrati
pictures.observations: Inspected960×720 distant street view. Broad gold dome,four pale slender minarets and low warm-stone mass are visible. Trees,distance and construction foreground obscure facade detail;the communications mast is not part of the mosque.

pictures.author: Mark Fischer
pictures.observations: Inspected960×638 entrance detail:three brass door groups in a pale warm-stone recess,coarse gold frames and blue-green tile fields. Original simplified color panels and door subdivisions only;no historic calligraphy or exact mosaic artwork is copied. This is not a complete elevation.

pictures.author: Shiraz Chakera
pictures.observations: Inspected960×718 full exterior. Gold central dome above a banded/windowed support,small golden cupolas,warm inward-battered facades with narrow vertical dark recesses,cusped parapet,and four pale minarets with flared collars and pointed bell-like caps. Third picture was needed because the first is distant and the second only entrance detail. Older condition is not a current measured elevation.
